rationale: Despite gapping up 19.6% on 9.22x relative volume, XERS has broken down below both session VWAP ($13.30) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.27), printing sequential lower highs and lower lows over the last five 1-minute bars to reach $13.10. Combined with severe broader market selling pressure (SPY -3.02%, VIXY +18.03%), this failure to hold VWAP favors a rotation back down toward the opening print of $12.51. Invalidation is placed at $13.38, cleanly above VWAP to protect against a reclaim of intraday buyer control.
